public_rationale: The explicit exclusivity statement is contradicted. Meta reported more than 700 million monthly active Meta AI users on January 29, 2025. On the ordinary reading, that is a meaningful userbase even if engagement, distribution, and monetization differ from ChatGPT. This verdict concerns the claim that only ChatGPT had meaningful users; it does not establish that OpenAI lacked systemic financial or narrative importance.
limitations: Meaningful is interpreted as substantial recurring active use.
Meta's figure is company-reported, and embedded distribution may produce different engagement from a standalone assistant.
The broader load-bearing characterization remains unscored.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI is a load-bearing company for the tech industry, narratively and financially, and ChatGPT is the only LLM product with a meaningful userbase.

statement.excerpt: OpenAI has become a load-bearing company for the tech industry, both as a narrative — as previously discussed, ChatGPT is the only Large Language Model company with any meaningful userbase — and as a financial entity.
statement.document_title: OpenAI Is A Systemic Risk To The Tech Industry

from_speaker: a load-bearing company for the tech industry
the only Large Language Model company with any meaningful userbase
our_interpretation: ChatGPT is a product rather than a company; the ordinary reading compares OpenAI's assistant with competing LLM assistants.
Meaningful userbase means substantial recurring active use. It does not require matching ChatGPT's usage, revenue, or engagement.
The ongoing observation is assessed over January–March 2025, the latest completed calendar quarter before the post.
The exclusivity statement is separately falsifiable. Load-bearing expresses a broader dependence claim without a specified threshold or failure test.
A contradiction of exclusivity does not establish that OpenAI lacked financial or narrative importance.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evidence establishes that ChatGPT alone had substantial recurring active use, while evidence of industry dependence supports the broader load-bearing characterization.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one competing LLM assistant demonstrably had substantial recurring active users during the target period, contradicting the explicit exclusivity statement.
